run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T23:11:04Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: Checkout's SS_CODE_ERROR spans in the sampled period 23:11:00-23:51:00 are confined to oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its outgoing HTTP POST; every failing PlaceOrder observed carries the exact status description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400" and rpc.grpc.status_code 13. In the failing traces the erroring checkout HTTP POST span is the direct parent of the shipping service's "/get-quote" server span, shipping answered in 31-469 microseconds and made no downstream "POST quote"/quote call, while in a successful trace the same POST took 17.75 ms and fanned out to shipping "POST quote" and quote "POST /getquote". Per sample, the difference between shipping "/get-quote" and shipping "POST quote" equals the checkout HTTP POST error count exactly (e.g. 365.6-237.8=127.8 vs 127.8 at 23:18, 122.9 vs 122.9 at 23:28), so the failing checkout requests are exactly the /get-quote calls that stopped short. The failure then surfaces as HTTP 500 at frontend (POST /api/checkout, grpc PlaceOrder) and at frontend-proxy. The error text names the email service, but no email span exists in any failing trace and email's span series are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the failing POST's child is shipping /get-quote, so the email attribution is inconsistent with the trace topology. In all three inspected failing traces no GetProduct or CurrencyService/Convert spans occur between GetCart and the shipping POST, so an item-less quote request is the leading hypothesis, but the request body and the reason shipping returned 400 are not observable, so the object where the fault originates cannot be established. Pods are all Running/ready with 0 restarts, no Evicted/OOMKilled events exist, and the only otel-demo change in the window is a load-generator rollout at 23:35:10Z that postdates the alert. flagd-config has all flags off except loadGeneratorFloodHomepage=100.

claims.text: Checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans exist only for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and span_name HTTP POST, with identical counts over time (e.g. 33.257777777777775 at 23:15, 296.84210526315786 at 23:25, 150.0350588235294 at 23:50, 10-minute increases); all other checkout span series returned (orders publish, CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert, PaymentService/Charge, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) are STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Checkout error-span activity is present in the earliest sample the store returned and persists: the status-split query over 22:00-23:51 returned its first sample at 23:11:00, with STATUS_CODE_ERROR rising from 0 (23:11) and 7.954666666666666 (23:12) to a peak of 305.2293333333333 (23:26) and still 150.0350588235294 per 10 minutes at 23:50, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans stay in the thousands.

The exact checkout error text is "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400" (otel.status_description and exception.message, 75 bytes) on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with status tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13; the same string is propagated to frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder as "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 400".

In trace fabf30c40bb674e79e93dd78836bb231 (23:15:42-23:15:43) checkout's error span operation "HTTP POST" (span 2f69d09d57973cd9, 826 µs, status error=true/otel.status_code=ERROR) has parent prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart (4e53d77d5e11686f) and child shipping span operation "/get-quote" (a170b05e15f5aeba, 469 µs, status not_recorded); the trace contains no email span and shipping's /get-quote has no child span and no "POST quote" span.

Two further failing traces show the same shape: trace adb3c50d1d124cff7b898569d2f8feba has checkout "HTTP POST" (c44a8ea1f74a7417, 1222 µs, error) -> shipping "/get-quote" (9ff8cea9a4d2a2dc, 45 µs) with only a CartService/GetCart call (1090 µs) before it and no GetProduct or CurrencyService/Convert span, and trace 7ca0fe45d87843d44530943dfd48166d has "HTTP POST" (06f9140c4e8cc2b1, 1115 µs, error) -> shipping "/get-quote" (e3ca9e61096b7952, 31 µs) after a CartService/GetCart of 786 µs with no GetProduct or Convert span.

In the successful comparison trace 03463095c70f822db5e7f6c234f10d36 (23:15:45) the same checkout "HTTP POST" (8a21fda4335b08ad, 18203 µs, not_recorded) has child shipping "/get-quote" (b6f8566552413994, 17752 µs) which has child shipping "POST quote" (87841d6c94e80c28) and quote "POST /getquote" (05aa9a6e39b1ed7b); the order then reaches email "POST /send_order_confirmation" (29a33d3ec8e17ad4) with http.status_code=200, and checkout PlaceOrder has rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

All frontend error spans at 23:40-23:51 are on the checkout path: POST /api/checkout 147.9069019607843, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 147.9069019607843, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 147.9069019607843 and POST 106.40784313725489 per 10 minutes, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc CartService/AddItem, grpc CartService/GetCart, grpc AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect error series are 0; those frontend spans carry status error=true and http.status_code=500.

Queries grouped by span_name and status_code for shipping, email and quote in 23:00-23:51 returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series: email has POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template; shipping has /get-quote, /ship-order and POST quote; quote has POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure}; no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for these three services.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no deletionTimestamp, including checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b, shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9, email-59f69bc6cf-7wqqk, cart-755465879b-j4pxv and valkey-cart-58df56c79c-kt7dp; the event list grouped by kind/namespace/reason contains no Evicted, OOMKilling or Unhealthy reason in otel-demo.

The only otel-demo change in the window is a load-generator rollout: Deployment load-generator (revision 2, pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:35:10Z, same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-load-generator) scaled up ReplicaSet load-generator-7d5756fbd9 from 0 to 1 and scaled down load-generator-c7cbc4c99 from 1 to 0 at 23:35:10-23:35:11, with ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete and Pod Created/Killing/Started events.

The flagd-config ConfigMap in otel-demo defines flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure all with defaultVariant "off"; the only flag whose value in effect is not off is loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, defaultVariant "100", description "Flood the frontend with a large amount of requests.", variants {off:0, on:100}.

Checkout runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080 and SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080; the email, shipping and quote Services select opentelemetry.io/name=email, shipping and quote respectively on port 8080, so the failing POST target topology is not explained by a Service selector mismatch.

The newest 60 lines of the shipping container log (23:45:29-23:45:59, 5685 lines in 23:05-23:45:59) are its normal flow strings "Requesting quote", "Sending Quote" and "Tracking ID Created", i.e. shipping logs the quote-service call for requests that proceed past /get-quote.

frontend-proxy "ingress" spans are already dominated by STATUS_CODE_ERROR at the earliest sample: 5506.666666666667 error vs 2680 UNSET per 5 minutes at 23:16, 7000.075666666666 vs 3433.8299999999995 at 23:26, 4892.222222222223 vs 980 at 23:41 and 3362.773666666667 vs 1416.4224 at 23:51, an error volume far larger than the checkout error counts and not confined to the checkout path.

The load-generator log lines shown (23:44:58-23:44:59) record "Checkout completed for user ..." and "Multi-item checkout completed for user ..." plus cart-add and browse actions, showing the generator drives distinct single-item and multi-item checkout tasks against user ids whose carts are populated by separate add-to-cart actions.

The failing checkouts carried an empty line-item list: in all three inspected failing traces no ProductCatalogService/GetProduct or CurrencyService/Convert span occurs between CartService/GetCart and the shipping POST (unlike the successful trace), and GetCart completed in 786-1090 µs there, so checkout posted an item-less quote request to shipping and shipping answered it with the 400 recorded in the error text.

Alternatively the shipping service's /get-quote handler itself rejects some otherwise valid quote requests: it answered in 31-469 µs without any downstream call and its own span carries no status tag, so a shipping-side validation/rejection defect cannot be separated from the item-less-request explanation with the available evidence.

The enabled loadGeneratorFloodHomepage=100 setting may raise the share of checkout attempts made against carts with no items (more load, more checkout attempts per user between add-to-cart actions), which would produce the observed 9-42% per-sample share of /get-quote rejections; this is unverified because no metric sample exists before 23:11 and the flag's change time is unknown.

The email service returning HTTP 400 is rejected as the source of these checkout failures: the failing traces contain no email span at all, the erroring checkout HTTP POST span's child is shipping "/get-quote", and email's span series for 23:00-23:51 are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET (the sampled successful trace shows email POST /send_order_confirmation with http.status_code=200).

A pod crash, OOM/eviction or a rollout of checkout/shipping/email is rejected as the cause: those pods are Running and ready with 0 restarts, no Evicted/OOMKilling/Unhealthy events exist for otel-demo, and the only rollout in the window is the load-generator one at 23:35:10Z, which postdates the first observed checkout error samples (23:12) and the alert start 23:11:04Z.

No error-status span series were returned for shipping, email, quote, payment, cart, product-catalog, currency or accounting in the incident window; the only services for which the error queries returned series were checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy and about 1 per 10 minutes on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation, so none of the downstream services observed here shows its own error-span signal.

gaps: No metric sample exists before 23:11:00 (the leftmost point returned by the 22:00-23:51 queries), so the pre-alert baseline is unknown and I cannot say when checkout errors began or whether the alert start 23:11:04Z coincides with an onset rather than with the start of available samples.

The Jaeger sample available for checkout covered only 23:15:24-23:15:54 (traces_search/read_evidence source range), so trace conclusions apply to that slice; checkout traces for 23:11-23:15 and 23:16-23:51 were not returned (a later 23:49-23:49:20 query returned no trace at all).

The request and response bodies of the checkout -> shipping /get-quote POST are not in the traces, shipping logs no rejection detail, and the query fetch_pod_logs with filter 'err|invalid|fail|400|expected' on shipping-75d58f5d84-kgmz9 (23:05-23:51) returned no matching lines, so both the exact rejection reason and whether the item list was empty remain unknown.

A fetch_pod_logs query for 'err|error|fail|exception|panic|declin|refus' on checkout-5dccddf8bb-vh65b (23:10-23:51, 12147 lines read) returned no matching lines; this shows only that those patterns matched nothing, not that the application logged no errors.
The email container returned 0 log bytes for 23:05-23:51 and the valkey-cart container returned 0 log bytes, so those logs could not be checked at all.

change_history is not integrated, so who or what set kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:35:10Z on Deployment load-generator, and when or by whom the flagd-config flag values were last changed, cannot be determined.

The frontend-proxy "ingress" error-span volume (3.4k-7k per 5 minutes) is unexplained and is not tied to checkout by the evidence; span metrics expose only status class, not HTTP status codes, so the failing request classes at the proxy are unknown.

Whether any email request was rejected with HTTP 400 cannot be excluded absolutely: a traces_search_by_tags for service email with http.status_code="400" over 23:15-23:51 returned no trace, but that is a query result over the sampled Jaeger store, not proof of absence.
next_steps: Capture the checkout -> shipping /get-quote request bodies and shipping's 400 responses (and enable rejection logging in the shipping handler) to confirm whether items are empty and which validation path returns 400.
Review checkout's handling of an empty cart before calling shipping, and correct the misleading error text that names the email service for a POST whose target is shipping /get-quote.
Examine why 9-42% of checkout attempts run against carts with no items (load-generator checkout task ordering versus cart emptying after a successful order, cart TTL).
Confirm the intended value of the flagd flag loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (currently "100") and check flagd audit/change history for when it was set.
Check container logging configuration for the email and valkey-cart pods, which produced no log output in the window.

Re-check the alert rule RequestErrorRate (list_prometheus_rules returned no rule named RequestErrorRate) against the Alertmanager definition to confirm the >0 threshold and the 0.2 value in the alert annotation.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

data.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    dimensions:
    - default: otel-demo
      name: namespace
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: http://clickhouse-clickhouse.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local:8123
    logs_table_name: otel_demo_logs
    password: ""
    traces_table_name: otel_demo_traces
    username: default
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch-master.opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector.opentelemetry-collectors.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - pull:
          exporter:
            prometheus:
              host: 0.0.0.0
              port: 8888
